attempts.raw_response: He explained that the idea for the tour came to him during lockdown when he was missing performing for live audiences. "I realized I wanted to do something truly ambitious, something that would take me to every corner of the country," he said. The comedian has been touring internationally for over a decade but this marks his first complete US tour. He also mentioned that if he ever becomes Mayor, he promises to make London the laughter capital of the world.

pair.human_continuation: 'Hub for comedy' Despite not spending much time in the country, the comedian who also appears the films Ocean's Twelve and Ocean's Thirteen, says there are a lot of talented British comedians. "London is a great hub for comedy. There are about 60-80 clubs," he said. Even though he likes to see other acts doing well, the comedian admits he has a competitive side. "You don't want them to be too funny. That can just knock you back a bit. "The highest praise is going to be, 'That's annoyingly good'. If they're equally as good, that's fine."
